[172] aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ manosucaritassa aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo vipāko nibbatteyya netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ manosucaritassa iṭṭho kanto manāpo vipāko nibbatteyya ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti .
